notes:
Reached entirely via Claude-in-Chrome (own tab). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic Disallow on /cart,/profile,/auth,/wishlist and the l1/l2/l3/brand/custom sitemap XML feeds - none blocked normal browsing); Sitemap: lines point to sitemap.xml, sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml, sitemap/sections.sitemap.xml. No bot wall encountered on any request. Tree source: the site's own React mega-menu (Sofas & Recliners / Living / Bedroom / Dining & Kitchen / Study / Storage Furniture / Lighting & Decor / Furnishing), clicked open one bucket at a time and read via accessibility tree - this is the real navigable IA. Cross-checked per the mandatory sitemap rule against sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml (1014 URLs): after excluding known noise patterns (colour variants, price-band pages e.g. 'sofa-sets-under-30000', brand-name pages, dummy/trial/test slugs, 'all-*' roll-ups, material/feature combo pages), the sitemap is overwhelmingly SEO longtail duplication of the same handful of product types (~600+ variant slugs) rather than a hidden branch of real categories - confirmed by spot-sampling ~15 candidates via h1 text. Six of those spot checks were genuine additional nodes not present in the mega-menu and were added: Futon, Entryway Coat Racks, Cribs, Changing Tables, Nursery Gliders, Kids Stools (all explicitly furniture per brief scope, e.g. nursery gliders/cribs). 'Kids Sofas' (/collection/kids-sofas) was also found in the sitemap but returns an implausible '9003 Products' header - larger than the entire site's general Sofas count (8541) - and was excluded as an evidently broken/misconfigured collection rather than reported as real.

QTY METHOD: rendered 'N Products' header (React SSR - confirmed identical whether read via full page navigation+get_page_text or same-origin fetch() of the same URL, so same-origin fetch was used for speed) plus the page's own 'Showing X of Y' pagination text as a second, independent confirmation from the same render (both read '8,541' on the worst case). All qty in this file come from that header; evidence field quotes it.

SITE-WIDE DUPLICATE-COLLECTION DEFECT FOUND AND HANDLED: several named menu items on this site are not independent collections - they return byte-identical first-N product listings (verified by comparing product name JSON) despite different slugs/h1/breadcrumbs, i.e. two menu labels pointing at the same backend dataset. Confirmed pairs: 'Sofa Sets' == 'Sofas' (8541 each); 'Chairs' == 'Arm Chairs' (1087 each); 'Computer Tables' == 'Desktop Tables' (258 each); 'Ergonomic Chairs' (Study Chairs) == 'Office Chairs' (Office Furnitures) (322 each); 'Showcases' == 'Bookshelves' (420 each); 'Cabinets & Sideboards' (Living Storage) == 'Crockery Units' (Kitchen Furniture) == the singular-slug alias 'crockery-unit' (240 each); 'shoe-racks' == its singular alias 'shoe-rack' (213 each). In every case only ONE row was kept (the more general / more standard-sounding label - Sofas, Chairs, Computer Tables, Office Chairs, Bookshelves, Cabinets & Sideboards, Shoe Racks) to avoid double-counting the same products under two rows; the dropped duplicate name is recorded here, not emitted as a row. Because Cabinets & Sideboards absorbed Crockery Units, 'Kitchen Furniture' collapsed to a single surviving child (Kitchen Cabinets) and was flattened - Kitchen Cabinets is emitted directly under Dining & Kitchen rather than as a further group. 'Gaming Chairs' and 'Benches' are each linked identically from two different menus (Living/Study and Living/Bedroom respectively) - emitted once each, under Living, not duplicated.

SCOPE EXCLUSIONS: Mattresses (bedding, excluded entirely per brief, incl. all mattress sub-types). Customizable Sofas (a /page/ builder flow, not a listing). New Arrivals / Deal Zone / New Collection / Oasis / Terra / Astra / Dawn Collection everywhere they appeared (seasonal marketing collections, banned by §3). Pet Furniture / Pet Beds (not human furniture, out of project scope). Material-only variant pages (Fabric/Wooden/Leatherette/Leather Sofas, Wooden Chairs, Metal Beds, Upholstered Beds) and pure size/door-count/feature facets (1/2/3-Seater Sofas & Recliners, King/Queen/Single Beds, Beds With/Without Storage, Hydraulic Beds, 1-4 Door Wardrobes, Sliding Wardrobes, seater-count Dining Sets, Motorized Recliners) were treated as filter pages of their parent product type per §3's price/colour/material-filter exclusion, not separate categories, to keep the row count sane on this unusually deep catalogue - the parent type (Sofas, Beds, Wardrobes, Recliner Sofas, Dining Table Sets) is reported instead. 'L Shaped Sofas' was kept as its own leaf (a genuine distinct silhouette, not a facet, analogous to a sectional).

SANITY CHECKS: counts vary category-to-category (not a constant/site-wide total, aside from the proven-alias pairs above). Live zero-stock categories (Kids Beds, Changing Tables, Nursery Gliders, Gaming Chairs) emitted as qty:0 leaves per §7b rather than omitted, each with its own '0 Products' evidence. This is a Reliance-owned multi-seller marketplace storefront (per prior Home-Decor pass notes) which explains genuinely large per-category counts (Beds 1430, Sofas 8541) - these were corroborated by the dual header+pagination-text read, not treated as suspect merely for being large.
